summary: Goosehead Insurance, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the appointment of John Martin as CFO effective April 20, 2026, replacing the prior CFO. The filing details Mr. Martin’s compensation: $400,000 base salary, 50% annual bonus target, and 40,000 stock options. No departure of a prior officer was explicitly cited as forced or abrupt, but the appointment itself is a C-suite change. The filing also includes routine quarterly results under Item 2.02. The event is classified as a management change due to the CFO transition being the central non-routine item. Watch for any subsequent filings that might disclose the predecessor’s departure circumstances.
